retained_failures: Initial proxy descriptor callback returned at most 4096 bytes per FUSE read, which FUSE treated as EOF. Fixed by filling the requested range with internally fenced 4096-byte chunks; receiver then read all 19035 bytes with matching SHA256.

Normal competing file commands retained explicit file_busy in 6 of 8 attempts; 2 roots calls succeeded and the receiver completed all 8 MiB with correct SHA256. No claim that all competing commands succeeded.

The first cleanup UI assertion sampled at 200 ms, before asynchronous completion; resumed inspection observed actual success and checked files/budget without reinjecting payloads or repeating cleanup.
review_counterexamples: Queued owner cleanup captures pairing, file epoch and session epoch; host tests reject owner switch or epoch change before subsequent deletion.
Recipient IO waits up to 5 seconds off-main with authorization rechecked every 50 ms; host thread test denies revoked waiting reads before the competing lock is released.
